::: {#def-irls}

#### Iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS)

Suppose the outcomes follow the [logistic regression model](#def-logistic-regression).
Let $X$ be the matrix whose rows are $\tp{\vpredvar_{\iobs}}$.
From a current [estimate](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) $\vcoef^*$ with fitted [probabilities](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) $\prob_{\iobs}^*$ (collected in $\vprob^*$), form

- the weights $w_{\iobs} = \prob_{\iobs}^* \paren{1 - \prob_{\iobs}^*}$, collected in the diagonal matrix $W$;
- the working responses $z_{\iobs} = \dprod{\vcoef^*}{\vpredvar_{\iobs}} + \paren{\outvar_{\iobs} - \prob_{\iobs}^*} / w_{\iobs}$, collected in $\vecf{z}$.

**Iteratively reweighted least squares** replaces $\vcoef^*$ by the weighted least squares fit of $\vecf{z}$ on $X$,
the minimizer of $\sum_{\iobs=1}^{\nobs} w_{\iobs} \paren{z_{\iobs} - \dprod{\vcoef}{\vpredvar_{\iobs}}}^2$,
which is

$$
\inv{\paren{\qform{W}{X}}} \tp{X} W \vecf{z},
$$

and repeats until the estimate stops changing.

:::
